mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_trace_unit_correction (unit_id, binding_id, reason, status, requested_by, requested_at, created_by) VALUES (#{unitId}, #{bindingId}, #{reason}, 'PENDING', #{requestedBy}, #{requestedAt}, #{requestedBy})
mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.unit_id AS unitId, u.unit_code AS unitCode, u.lot_id AS lotId, t.lot_no AS lotNo, c.binding_id AS bindingId, b.customer_name_snapshot AS customerName, b.order_no_snapshot AS orderNo, c.reason, c.status, c.requested_by AS requestedBy, c.requested_at AS requestedAt, c.decided_by AS decidedBy, c.decided_at AS decidedAt, c.decision_reason AS decisionReason, c.version FROM xsy_trace_unit_correction c JOIN xsy_trace_unit u ON u.id = c.unit_id LEFT JOIN xsy_trace_lot t ON t.id = u.lot_id LEFT JOIN xsy_trace_unit_binding b ON b.id = c.binding_id
mapper.select: WHERE c.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE OF c
SELECT count(*) FROM xsy_trace_unit_correction WHERE unit_id = #{unitId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE xsy_trace_unit_correction SET status = #{status}, decided_by = #{operator}, decided_at = #{decidedAt}, decision_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_trace_unit_unbind (unit_id, binding_id, correction_id, reason, unbound_at, unbound_by, created_by) VALUES (#{unitId}, #{bindingId}, #{correctionId}, #{reason}, #{unboundAt}, #{operator}, #{operator})

INSERT INTO xsy_trace_event (unit_id, lot_id, event_type, source_document_type, source_document_id, occurred_at, operator, remark, created_by) VALUES (#{unitId}, #{lotId}, 'UNBIND', 'TRACE_UNIT_CORRECTION', #{correctionId}, #{occurredAt}, #{operator}, #{reason}, #{operator})
